tool_config.name: prepare_loan
tool_config.description: Prepare accepting her loan offer. Read back what she receives, the cost and the total in naira, and how she repays (10% of every money-in, at least ₦2,500 every two weeks). Accepting always needs her PIN on the screen.

amount.description: Loan amount in naira if she asked for less than her offer, a whole number she said. Leave out to take the full offer.
